comment: A Defiler of the human player with Dark Swarm, Plague and Consume researched casts Dark Swarm (W) at a point near a computer player's Marines, consumes (C) its own Zergling and casts Plague (G) at the Marines: CreateDarkSwarm 0x43dc10 and its cover (0x41fa00), ApplyConsume 0x43db70, the Plague area 0x43db50 with its damage ticks.
